_comment: Grandfather + gating config for verify-frozen-provenance.py. Result docs dated on/after `gating_date` HARD-FAIL on a Frozen-label criterion that is not byte-present in the lane's prereg (or that resolve no prereg at all); docs dated before it are WARN-ONLY (grandfathered by the pre-gate date). `grandfathered_result_docs` is an explicit escape hatch for a doc dated on/after the cutoff (repo-relative path; normally empty, reviewable diff). `incidents` are the documented motivating failures, both caught by adversarial review and corrected in-place (Rule 12) before this gate existed — annotated here so the warn output and any reader see the class this gate closes.

incidents.description: The driver JSON hard-coded the note "ROBUST across rail depth (S_RAIL 0.03->0.003 all RISING, pressure-tested)" and surfaced it as a frozen/pressure-tested result; the string was never in the prereg and never computed (only S_RAIL=0.03 was run). See result-doc section 7.5.
incidents.status: caught-and-corrected (adversarial review; Rule-12 retraction in the merged doc)

incidents.description: The Lame gate was banked on an ABSOLUTE two-shell agreement `|ext1-ext2| <= 0.10` mislabeled "Frozen:", swapped for the actual frozen criterion `|Delta|/mean <= 0.25` (prereg section 4 Leg 2). See result-doc section 7.6.
incidents.status: caught-and-corrected (adversarial review; re-banked on the frozen deliverable in the merged doc)
